# ENet 1.3.18

Reliable UDP networking library by Lee Salzman, https://github.com/lsalzman/enet (MIT licence, `LICENSE`).
Used by the port's native multiplayer transport (`port/common/net/`, [MULTIPLAYER.md](../../docs/MULTIPLAYER.md)).

Copied unchanged from the release tag `v1.3.18`: the archive
`https://github.com/lsalzman/enet/archive/refs/tags/v1.3.18.tar.gz` (82,923 bytes, SHA-256
`28603c895f9ed24a846478180ee72c7376b39b4bb1287b73877e5eae7d96b0dd`, downloaded 2026-10-25). Only the
library sources, headers, `LICENSE`, `README` and `ChangeLog` are kept; upstream's build files, docs and
Doxygen configuration are omitted. `.gitattributes` keeps these bytes exact (`-text`).
